summary.text: John Hughes is a Republican state representative who has represented South Dakota House District 13 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

An attorney and business owner, he is vice chair of the House Taxation Committee and faces Democrat Ali Horsted, along with fellow Republican incumbent Jack Kolbeck, for the district's two seats, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: John Hughes was born in Huron, South Dakota, and earned a bachelor's degree from South Dakota State University and a law degree from the University of Nebraska College of Law, according to Ballotpedia.

Ballotpedia lists his career experience as attorney and business owner and his 2025-2026 committee assignments as the House Judiciary Committee and the House Taxation Committee, where he is vice chair.
